resources.string: Choose an AI model to download.
All models work offline and answer using the downloaded guides. What differs is how they were prepared.
General-purpose models, as published by their authors. They can do a bit of everything, but sometimes answer with their own knowledge instead of the guide, or don\'t say when the guide isn\'t enough.
The same kinds of model, trained by Pocket Travel on travel guides: they answer in Italian in a few sentences, using only what\'s in the guide, and clearly say when a piece of information is missing.
%1$s is about %2$s and you\'re on mobile data. Continue?
In Online mode your questions go to an AI service of your choice, using your own API key. Pick the service, create a key on its website and paste it below.
The key stays only on this phone, encrypted. Questions go straight to %1$s, never to a Pocket Travel server, and you pay for usage on your own account. Switching service deletes the key.
Ask a question about the region
Answers come from the region\'s guide and your notes, in a few sentences. If the guide isn\'t enough, it tells you.
Always verify with the official source
You\'ll need to download it again to use the on-device AI assistant.
